opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs), and exempt/excepted organisations under Charity Commission guidance, with at least one year's worth of annual accounts (independently audited or examined, or a Charity Commission annual return). Cannot fund individuals, CICs, community benefit societies, social enterprises, local authorities/councils.
opportunities.summary: Grants under £100,000 for operating/core costs, capital projects, or projects/specific activities. Open to applications all year round with no deadlines. Grants typically support around 10-20% of an organisation's total annual budget (operating/core costs), around 10-20% of capital costs (with ~50% of capital funding expected to be secured), and around 10-20% of project costs. For local community projects (e.g. village halls, places of worship) grants are typically no greater than £30,000.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For capital or project costs: the total cost of the project must be at least £1 million regardless of the organisation's annual income. For core costs: the organisation's annual income must be at least £1 million. Must be a UK registered charity, CIO, or exempt/excepted organisation under Charity Commission guidance, with at least one year's worth of annual accounts.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £100,000 and over, considered by Trustees at one of eight Board meetings per year. Applications are made via an Expression of Interest form, which can be submitted all year round with no deadlines. Expressions of Interest are reviewed on a rolling basis; if taken forward, applicants are invited to submit a full proposal for consideration at a board meeting.
